summary: Request: Time-limited minimal hashed log slice for customer email-merge remediation
description:
Issue summary: Customer support engineering needs a tightly-scoped, time-limited extract of production inference log records to reconcile an email-merge event for a single enterprise customer. The extract must be minimized (hashed identifiers, token-level redaction where applicable) and scoped to a specific 30-minute window and a set of request IDs provided below.

Impact: Without access, the customer-facing remediation (correcting merged profiles in their downstream system) is blocked and the customer has opened a legal data correction request. This is limited to one customer and is not a platform-wide incident.

Environment: prod, region: eu-west.

Request details: Provide a hashed-keyed slice of inference request/response metadata for these request IDs: r-20260310-agg-04, r-20260310-agg-08, r-20260310-agg-11. Returned fields: timestamp, request_id, truncated_request_hash (sha256, first 16 chars), truncated_response_hash (sha256, first 16 chars), model_version, route, truncated_client_ip (CIDR /24 masked), user_agent, redaction_marker (yes/no). No raw customer prompt text, no raw output, and no full PII.

Justification & compliance controls: This is a minimal slice needed for the customer's data merge verification. The requestor is Support Engineer Noor Qureshi on behalf of Customer Success (EU enterprise account). Access must be timeboxed (max 72 hours), read-only, stored only in a secured ephemeral S3 bucket with KMS encryption, and shared with the customer via secure upload only after approval from Legal and Privacy. Audit trail of who accessed the export must be recorded.

Data minimization plan: Apply prefix stripping on any prompt-like fields, replace named-entity tokens with category markers, and compute only truncated hashes for linkage. No key material, no raw inference tokens, and no KV-cache snapshots are permitted.

Requested duration: 72 hours from provisioning.

Approvers required: Privacy, Legal, Oncall SRE for export process signoff.

Runbook references: see confluence page and runbook links below for export procedure and redaction patterns.
justification: Customer data-merge verification for single enterprise account; legal data correction pending. Minimal probing required to map hashed identifiers between systems.
data_minimization: Truncate hashes, mask IPs to /24, redact token sequences and named entities, exclude KV cache and raw prompt/output fields.
access_controls: Ephemeral S3 with KMS, ACL restricted to requestor + approvers, short-lived presigned URL for download, all actions audited in CloudTrail.
